Given my private value of $6 for the prize, my goal is to maximize profit. Since this is the only round, I should bid below my value to ensure a profit if I win. Bidding too high risks paying more than the prize is worth. A bid slightly above half my value, say $3, could prevent overbidding while still having a chance at winning if others bid conservatively. This strategy minimizes loss and maximizes potential gain, considering the random nature of opponents' values.
